# Sales Brunch and Learn
Date: 2026-08-28 | Duration: 51m

## Summary
The team discussed expanding partnerships, notably with a Berlin-based legal AI firm and a potential Asian channel partner, highlighting the latter's implementation capabilities for large telcos. They reviewed a shift to event-based pricing from September 15, noting existing challenges with legacy accounts that require manual management. Sales enablement efforts include creating a new sales organization for platform trials, emphasizing Super Admin access, and initiating demo certifications to enhance demo quality. Additionally, insights on feature flag management through AI tools to clean up stale configurations were shared, alongside plans to promote new product launches like session replay. The meeting also emphasized the importance of team culture through social learning sessions.

## Keywords
Sales enablement, Pricing strategy, Trial licenses, Feature flags, AI personalization, Onboarding challenges

## Action Items
